resources.string: Telegram Speed Hook
Telegram download and video loading optimization with download profiles and local logs. Original author: AraafRoyall.
Telegram Speed Hook\n%s

Tune download concurrency and video loading.

Choose a download profile, enable video optimization if needed, then save and reopen Telegram. Grant Root permission on first use.
Saving stops Telegram and interrupts active downloads and calls.
Save and stop Telegram
Settings service unavailable. Enable this module in an API 101+ framework, grant Root for migration, then close and reopen the module.

Connected · Settings synchronized with LSPosed.
Saving… Check for a Root permission prompt.

Download profiles
Balanced: 1 MiB chunks, up to 4 logical lanes and 8 requests.
High requests: 1 MiB chunks, up to 4 logical lanes and 12 requests.
Original: keep ordinary downloads unchanged; video optimization is controlled separately.
Actual speed depends on your network, proxy route and Telegram servers.

Settings apply when Telegram next starts. If automatic stopping fails, force-stop it manually and reopen it.

Video optimization

Prioritize data at the current playback position and update the target chunks when seeking. Independent of the download profile and off by default. New video tasks use smaller chunks and separate concurrency settings; existing tasks keep their chunk size.
